info.title: ALIBI
info.description: ALIBI - Personal productivity and adaptive planning backend

get.description: Returns whether the application requires owner initialization.

post.description:
First-time owner creation with default workspace and system categories.

Fails with 403 Forbidden on subsequent invocations (AC-M1-2).

Authenticate owner, track client device, and issue JWT/refresh tokens.

Enforces sliding-window rate limiting (AC-M1-4). Sets HttpOnly cookie on web clients.

post.summary: Rotate refresh token and issue new access token
post.description: Rotate refresh token. Detects token reuse and revokes entire family (AC-M1-3, AC-SEC-2).
Revoke session tokens and clear authentication cookies.

get.summary: Get current user profile and settings
get.description: Fetch profile of current authenticated user.

patch.description: Update profile attributes (display name, timezone, custom settings).

post.summary: Change password and revoke all sessions
post.description: Change account password with policy checks and revoke all session tokens.

get.description: List all registered, non-revoked client devices.

schema.title: Response List Devices Api V1 Auth Devices Get

delete.description: Revoke a device and all its active refresh tokens.

get.description: List all categories for the authenticated owner, ordered by position.

schema.title: Response List Categories Api V1 Categories Get

post.description: Create a new custom user category.

patch.description: Update custom or system category settings.

delete.description: Delete category. Fails with 409 Conflict if category is a system category (AC-M1-9).

get.description: List all active projects.

schema.title: Response List Projects Api V1 Projects Get

post.description: Create a new project.

get.description: List all active tags.

schema.title: Response List Tags Api V1 Tags Get

post.description: Create or retrieve a tag.
Capture task from natural language text (FR-TASK-001, AC-M2-1).

get.description: Fetch latest extraction proposal for a task.

schema.title: Response Get Task Extraction Api V1 Tasks  Task Id  Extraction Get

post.description: Confirm, correct, or reject proposed extraction fields.
Create a task with full fields.

get.description: List tasks by view (Today, Upcoming, Backlog, Completed, All) with filters (AC-M2-6).

schema.title: Response List Tasks Api V1 Tasks Get

get.description: Get single task details.

delete.description: Delete task: soft delete into trash, or hard purge if hard=true.

post.description: Change task status (AC-M2-3 validated transition table).
Reschedule task deadline, incrementing reschedule_count (FR-TASK-011).
Restore a task from trash.

get.description: Fetch chronological activity history for a task (AC-M2-4).

schema.title: Response Get Task History Api V1 Tasks  Task Id  Events Get

post.description: Add a subtask to a task.

patch.description: Toggle completion or update title of a subtask.

post.description: Reorder subtasks by ID list.

schema.title: Response Reorder Subtasks Api V1 Tasks  Task Id  Subtasks Reorder Post

post.description: Add a dependency (task_id depends on depends_on_task_id) with cycle check (AC-M2-7).

schema.title: Response Add Task Dependency Api V1 Tasks  Task Id  Dependencies Post

post.description: Start running timer on a task.
Stop an active running timer.
Log manual time entry against a task.

get.description: List time entries for a given task.

schema.title: Response List Time Entries Api V1 Time Entries Get

get.description: Get the currently running timer, or null if no timer is active.

schema.title: Response Get Running Timer Api V1 Time Entries Running Get

post.description: Upload file attachment or add link/note evidence to a task.

get.description: List all evidence attached to a task.

schema.title: Response List Task Evidence Api V1 Tasks  Task Id  Evidence Get

get.description: Download evidence file attachment. Strictly requires authentication (AC-M2-9).
Retrieve summarized metrics (time spent, completions, pending, overdue, rates) for period.
Retrieve transparent productivity score v1 (0-100 or null if insufficient data).
Return the transparent definition and rules of Productivity Score Formula v1.
Retrieve time-series of task completion counts for trend line/bar charts.

schema.title: Response Get Completion Trend Api V1 Analytics Charts Completion Trend Get

get.description: Retrieve time logged grouped by category with percentages for donut/bar charts.

schema.title: Response Get Time Distribution Api V1 Analytics Charts Time Distribution Get

get.description: Retrieve daily completed tasks and minutes logged for 1-year calendar heatmap.

schema.title: Response Get Consistency Heatmap Api V1 Analytics Charts Consistency Heatmap Get

get.description: Retrieve estimated vs actual minutes comparison for completed tasks.

schema.title: Response Get Est Vs Actual Api V1 Analytics Charts Est Vs Actual Get

get.description: Retrieve category workload metrics (completed, open, and logged minutes).

schema.title: Response Get Category Workload Api V1 Analytics Charts Category Workload Get

get.description: Get the current global AI external permission state (default False).

put.description: Toggle external AI outbound calls master switch.

get.description: List configured AI providers for the user with masked keys (key_last4).

schema.title: Response List Providers Api V1 Ai Providers Get

put.description: Update AI provider settings. API keys are strictly write-only and encrypted at rest.

delete.description: Delete the encrypted API key for a provider.

post.description: Test connectivity and credential validity for a provider.

get.description: Get aggregated usage metrics and estimated cost per provider/model.

post.description: Transcribe voice audio to text without persisting audio to disk (privacy by default).
Transcribe voice audio and run it through the grounded task extraction pipeline.

get.description: Get the user's compiled learning profile, maturity metrics, and routines.

post.description: Predict task duration with calibrated confidence intervals (doc 07 §5).

get.description: List active and candidate behavioral patterns (routines, work periods).

schema.title: Response List Learned Patterns Api V1 Learning Patterns Get

post.description: Reset all learned models, patterns, predictions, and profile snapshots (AC-PLE-7).
Generate intelligent schedule proposal respecting hard constraints.

get.description: Get schedule recommendation by ID.

post.description: Apply, partially apply, or reject schedule proposal (AC-SCH-4 stale check).

get.description: List calendar events and scheduled work blocks.

schema.title: Response List Calendar Events Api V1 Scheduling Events Get

post.description: Create a fixed calendar event (e.g. meeting, class, appointment).
Manually create and chunk a note in the personal knowledge vault.

get.description: List recent knowledge vault notes for current user.

schema.title: Response List Notes Api V1 Vault Notes Get

post.description: Execute keyword, semantic vector, or hybrid RRF search over user knowledge items.

schema.title: Response Search Vault Api V1 Vault Search Post

schema.title: Response List Chat Threads Api V1 Assistant Threads Get

get.description: Retrieve message history for a specific conversation thread.

schema.title: Response Get Thread Messages Api V1 Assistant Threads  Thread Id  Messages Get

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Write-only plaintext API key, encrypted before storage

score.title: Score
score.description: Productivity score 0-100 or None if insufficient data

password.title: Password
password.description: Password must be at least 12 characters

total_time_min.title: Total Time Min
total_time_min.description: Total minutes spent in period overlapping entries

tasks_completed.title: Tasks Completed
tasks_completed.description: Count of tasks completed in period

tasks_pending.title: Tasks Pending
tasks_pending.description: Count of open tasks as of period end

tasks_overdue.title: Tasks Overdue
tasks_overdue.description: Count of open tasks past deadline

completion_rate.title: Completion Rate
completion_rate.description: Completion rate or None if insufficient data

on_time_rate.title: On Time Rate
on_time_rate.description: On-time completion rate or None if insufficient data

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.description: Estimate-to-actual ratio or None if insufficient data

estimate_accuracy.title: Estimate Accuracy
estimate_accuracy.description: Share within +-25% or None if insufficient data
